title: Deep Learning-Based Classification and Targeted Gene Alteration Prediction from Pleural Effusion Cell Block Whole-Slide Images
summary: The source reports diagnostic classification and gene-alteration prediction results on a clinical image dataset. Results are limited to the evaluated slides and dataset; prospective or external clinical validation is not established.
ai_technology: A deep-learning model classifies pleural-effusion whole-slide images and predicts targeted gene alterations.
